items.title: 46% fewer nodes, 2× faster indexing: Confluent on Amazon OpenSearch Service
items.summary: How Confluent modernized its Amazon OpenSearch Service observability hot tier, ingesting hundreds of terabytes of logs per day, by migrating from r6gd to the purpose-built oi2 instance family. A measure-first approach cut the fleet 46%, roughly halved indexing latency, and cleared write backpressure, lowering cost even at a higher per-node price.
items.creator: Sukanth Rajan
